faq.q: What happened to Russia in World War One?
faq.a: Huge losses, hunger and anger led to revolution in 1917. The tsar was overthrown, the Bolsheviks under Lenin took power, and Russia left the war in 1918.
asks: Why did Russia leave World War One?

faq.a: An agreement to stop fighting, which began at 11 am on 11 November 1918. Many countries mark it as Armistice Day or Remembrance Day.
asks: When did World War One end?

faq.q: What did the Treaty of Versailles do?
faq.a: Signed in 1919, it made Germany accept responsibility for the war, give up land and colonies, limit its army to 100,000 men and pay reparations. Many historians think its harshness fed later resentment.
asks: Was the Treaty of Versailles fair?

faq.q: What was the League of Nations?
faq.a: An international organisation founded in 1920 to settle disputes peacefully. It had some successes but failed to stop aggression in the 1930s, partly because the USA never joined.
asks: Why did the League of Nations fail?

faq.a: Former German colonies and Ottoman lands that the League of Nations placed under the rule of Allied powers, such as Britain and France, supposedly until they were ready to govern themselves.

facts: The Armistice ending fighting in World War One took effect at 11 am on 11 November 1918.
The Treaty of Versailles was signed on 28 June 1919.
The League of Nations was founded in 1920.

quiz.say: Which of these empires ended after World War One?
quiz.show: Which empire ended after World War One?
quiz.why: Austria-Hungary broke up into several new countries in 1918.

wrong.1: The Mughal Empire ended in 1857 to 1858.
wrong.2: The Western Roman Empire ended in 476 CE.

quiz.say: What did the Treaty of Versailles make Germany pay?
quiz.why: Reparations were payments for war damage.

wrong.1: Germany was made to pay large sums.
wrong.2: The payments were money and goods, not tea.
